jobs.title: Credit Analyst / Credit Officer
jobs.description:
Role Description We are seeking analytical and finance-oriented professionals for the positions of Credit Analyst / Credit Officer
. These roles focus on credit risk assessment, financial evaluation, lending support, credit portfolio monitoring, and the management of credit-related activities. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong financial knowledge, numerical abilities, critical thinking, and an understanding of lending principles, credit policies, and risk management practices.
Responsibilities include reviewing credit applications, evaluating financial statements, assessing borrowers' repayment capacity, and analyzing creditworthiness based on financial information and supporting documentation. Professionals will conduct credit risk assessments, review income and cash flow information, evaluate existing financial obligations, and prepare credit evaluation reports to support lending decisions. Additional duties include monitoring credit accounts, identifying potential repayment risks, reviewing credit limits, maintaining accurate customer records, and ensuring that credit assessments comply with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements. They will also coordinate with relationship managers, banking operations teams, and relevant departments to clarify financial information, resolve documentation issues, and support effective credit management processes.
Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of credit analysis, lending procedures, and financial risk management.
Knowledge of financial statement analysis, cash flow assessment, and credit evaluation.
Ability to assess borrowers' financial positions and repayment capacity.
Familiarity with credit reports, loan documentation, and credit monitoring procedures.
Understanding of banking regulations, credit policies, and internal control requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis tools.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, report-writing, and documentation skills.
High attention to detail, professional integrity, and sound financial judgment.

jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Description
This part-time remote Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst role focuses on identifying, assessing, and mitigating fraud and financial crime risks related to the company’s operations and transactions. The analyst will review financial data, project documentation, and payment flows to detect anomalies, suspicious patterns, and potential control weaknesses. Daily tasks include conducting risk assessments, performing data analysis, preparing concise reports, and recommending preventive and corrective actions to management. The role also involves collaborating with finance and project teams, supporting investigations, maintaining documentation for audits, and contributing to the enhancement of internal controls, policies, and monitoring frameworks.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills with demonstrated ability to interpret complex data, detect patterns, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
Candidates should possess Risk Analysis skills, including experience assessing fraud and financial crime exposure and evaluating control effectiveness.
Candidates should possess Finance knowledge, with familiarity in financial statements, project payments, budgeting, and transactional workflows.
Candidates should possess Communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly in written reports and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Candidates should possess Statistics skills, including basic proficiency in quantitative methods, trend analysis, and use of analytical tools or spreadsheets.
Relevant experience in fraud risk, financial crime compliance, internal audit, or forensic accounting is highly beneficial.
Professional certifications such as CFE, CAMS, or similar risk/compliance credentials are an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage part-time hours effectively, and handle confidential information with integrity.
